interaction_steps.prompt: logx能否支持一下全局添加field功能，或默认加一个serviceName，收集日志想根据服务分索引很不方便

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'PROJECT_BRIEF.md' -g '*logx*' -g 'go.mod' | head -80 && printf '%s\\n' '--- top-level ---' && ls -la"

/bin/zsh -lc "find . -name AGENTS.md -o -name PROJECT_BRIEF.md; find . -type d -name logx -print; rg -n \"func (Info|With|Add|Fields)|type .*Logger|serviceName|ServiceName|WithContext\" core -g '*.go' | head -200"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' core/logx/logs.go; sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/fields.go; sed -n '1,180p' core/logx/logger.go; sed -n '1,180p' core/logx/richlogger.go; sed -n '1,180p' core/logx/vars.go; sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/logs_test.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '220,520p' core/logx/logs.go; sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/writer.go 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n \"writeInfo|writeError|writeDebug|writeSevere|writeStack|fields\" core/logx -g '*.go'"

/bin/zsh -lc "git log --oneline --all -- core/logx | head -30; rg -n \"Global|global.*field|service.*field|Add.*Field|Set.*Field\" . -g '*.go' -g '*.md' | head -100; sed -n '240,390p' core/logx/writer.go; sed -n '1,120p' core/logx/fields_test.go; sed -n '1,100p' core/logx/config.go"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git show --stat --oneline 84db9bcd && git show 84db9bcd -- core/logx | head -300; git branch -a --contains 84db9bcd | head'

/bin/zsh -lc "git show 84db9bcd -- core/logx/logs.go core/logx/fields.go core/logx/writer.go core/logx/logx.go 2>&1 | head -400; git log --all -S'globalFields' --oneline -- core/logx; git log --all -S'GlobalFields' --oneline -- core/logx"
/bin/zsh -lc "git remote -v; git status --short; git log -1 --format='%H %s'; rg -n \"logx\\.\" core/logx/*_test.go | tail -50"
file_change
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w core/logx/fields.go core/logx/fields_test.go core/logx/logs.go core/logx/richlogger.go && go test ./core/logx'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- core/logx/fields.go core/logx/logs.go core/logx/richlogger.go core/logx/fields_test.go && git status --short'
